subject: Picobble on a one-owner web page?
text:
Hi faso,

I opened Picobble’s daily grid and read the scoring rules: crossword-style words, points per letter, and modifiers that change the puzzle. That compact browser-game format is why I thought of it for this.

I built Take The Wall: one public page with one featured owner. Would you be interested in putting Picobble on it? A takeover replaces the current content until somebody else takes over.

Browsing and previewing are free. Publishing costs $3.99, with no guaranteed audience or duration — this is an early internet experiment.

https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=personal&utm_medium=outreach&utm_campaign=first_owners&utm_content=picobble

No need to reply if it’s not for you; I won’t send follow-up reminders.

Take The Wall
